The following skills are available for use with the Skill tool:

- plugin-authoring: Make a mod: a change to Claude's own interface or behaviour, such as a panel or pane that stays beside the chat and updates, a band, status line, toast, slash command, or hook on tool calls. Use to make, change or debug a mod or its hooks module.

<command-args>You are working in a Linux container. Complete the task described below. Work on your own until it is done; nobody is available to answer questions. When you are done, stop. The state of the container when you stop is what gets graded.

<task>
[b1-session command-stop] [b1-script stop] add() in calc.py returns the difference of its arguments. Make it return their sum.
</task>

When you finish, end your final message with one line: STATUS: FIXED or STATUS: NOT FIXED.</command-args>

For bug fixes (Prove-It pattern):
1. Write a test that reproduces the bug (must FAIL)
2. Confirm the test fails
3. Implement the fix
4. Confirm the test passes
5. Run the full test suite for regressions
